name: The Bulls Head
heroEyebrow: The heart of the High Street
strapline: A proper village pub. Good beer, good company, no fuss.
shortWelcome: Drinks, conversation and a warm welcome in the centre of Bidford.
aboutHeading: A pub made for popping in.
aboutLead: A village local on Bidford High Street, reopened under new management in August 2025.
aboutBody: The Bulls Head is a relaxed place to meet, have a pint and stay awhile. With cask ale, a garden, live music and a traditional pub atmosphere, the focus is simple: a friendly local that feels easy to walk into.

index.t06: The Bulls Head has been part of Bidford life for more than 200 years. Reopened under new management in August 2025, it remains a traditional High Street local built around good beer, good company and a warm welcome.

visit.t03: The Bulls Head is at 36 High Street, right in the centre of Bidford-on-Avon. The 247 Stratford–Redditch and 28 Stratford–Evesham bus services stop close by.
